california_housing.description: Predict the median house value of a California census block using its location and housing statistics. Counts describe a block, not one household. This is an IID tabular regression task, not forecasting.

columns.housing_median_age: Median age of housing in the block, years
columns.total_rooms: Total rooms in the census block
columns.total_bedrooms: Total bedrooms in the census block
columns.population: Total population in the census block
columns.households: Number of households in the census block
columns.median_income: Median household income, in units of 10000 USD
columns.ocean_proximity: Categorical description of proximity to the ocean

adult_income.description: Predict the income bracket (over 50K or at most 50K) from demographic, education and employment features. Optimize Macro F1, giving both classes equal weight. Missing categorical entries are unknown values. IID binary classification.

concrete_strength.description: Predict concrete compressive strength in MPa from its ingredients and curing age. Ingredient quantities are kg per cubic metre of concrete; age is in days. This is tabular regression. Optimize RMSE on unseen concrete samples.

columns.cement: Cement content, kg per cubic metre
columns.blast_furnace_slag: Blast furnace slag content, kg per cubic metre
columns.fly_ash: Fly ash content, kg per cubic metre
columns.water: Water content, kg per cubic metre
columns.superplasticizer: Superplasticizer content, kg per cubic metre
columns.coarse_aggregate: Coarse aggregate content, kg per cubic metre
columns.fine_aggregate: Fine aggregate content, kg per cubic metre

dry_beans.description: Classify dry beans into seven varieties from geometric measurements of individual beans. Optimize Macro F1 across all varieties. Inputs are tabular geometric features, not images. IID multiclass classification.

columns.Area: Area enclosed by the bean boundary, pixels
columns.MajorAxisLength: Length of the major axis of the fitted ellipse
columns.MinorAxisLength: Length of the minor axis of the fitted ellipse
columns.AspectRation: Ratio of major and minor axis lengths
columns.EquivDiameter: Diameter of a circle with the same area
columns.Extent: Area divided by bounding box area
columns.Solidity: Area divided by convex hull area
columns.roundness: Roundness derived from area and perimeter
columns.Compactness: Equivalent diameter divided by major axis length
columns.ShapeFactor1: Shape descriptor derived from bean geometry
columns.ShapeFactor2: Shape descriptor derived from bean geometry
columns.ShapeFactor3: Shape descriptor derived from bean geometry
columns.ShapeFactor4: Shape descriptor derived from bean geometry
